summary: 7-phase plan written against the research report (not the stale brief). Ordering is the plan's main contribution: Phase 1 captures the green lake build baseline the research cycle could not (guarded + detached), Phase 2 rewrites typst/chapters/p2-frame-classes.typ BEFORE any deletion so typst-sync-check.sh reaches 0 violations at pre-deletion HEAD -- clearing the 2 inherited violations and pre-empting the 3-name text-grep trap -- Phase 3 repoints the 11 ungated #leansrc pointers, Phase 4 deletes the 6 paths + drops the FormalSystem.lean:13 import + appends the C11 Boneyard waiver as one atomic-batch commit, Phases 5-6 repair README/docs links and record the corrected archived-completeness finding, Phase 7 sweeps all four gates against the Phase 1 baseline. Estimated 5.5 hours.

artifacts.summary: 7-phase deletion plan with wave map [[1],[2,3],[4],[5,6],[7]], per-phase verification tiers, and Scope Hypothesis lines on all five count-asserting phases.

decisions_made: Brief item (b) is NOT re-planned: the ValidOver/ValidLinear/ValidDenseFc/ValidDiscreteFc/ValidOverInt vocabulary was already deleted by e5a9ba40f. Only the 81-line Validity.lean file (two FrameOver D fibration bridges, zero consumers) is removed, as part of the whole-directory deletion.

The brief's C6 acceptance criterion is DROPPED and restated as A3: C6 must still pass at 17 unreachable modules with scripts/module-invariants-manifest.txt UNMODIFIED. Phase 4 carries an explicit MUST NOT against adding a manifest entry, and Phase 7 asserts an empty git diff on that path.

typst rewrite is sequenced BEFORE deletion (Phase 2 blocks Phase 4), not after. typst-sync-check.sh check 1 is a text grep over .lean files, so the retirement prose in the doomed files is what currently keeps ValidLinear/ValidDenseFc/ValidDiscreteFc passing; rewriting first drives the gate to 0 at pre-deletion HEAD and turns an inherited RED gate into a repair rather than a regression.
A4 is framed as a repair, not a hold: typst-sync-check.sh is already FAIL at HEAD with TOTAL_VIOLATIONS=2, so 'no regression' is not an acceptable exit -- the target is 0.

Phase 4 declares Commit Mode: atomic-batch. Every intermediate ordering of (delete files / drop import / add waiver) leaves the tree or C11 red, and the plan forbids widening the batch mid-flight if an unexpected importer appears.

The Boneyard file StrictSemanticsLegacy/FrameConditions/Completeness.lean is retained with an explicit MUST NOT against deleting it; its dangling import is waived in scripts/boneyard-import-waivers.txt (waived count 6 -> 7).
Phase 1 is a hard gate: if the lake build baseline is not green, the phase is marked [BLOCKED] and execution stops rather than deleting into a red tree.
next_action_hint: Dispatch /implement 510. Phase 1 must complete (green guarded detached build + four gate baselines) before any other phase begins; Phase 4 must not begin before Phase 2 reaches TOTAL_VIOLATIONS=0.
